card.name: Incidence and percent of patients affected
card.fires_on: The word "incidence" after "higher" or "overall", and the % sign after a number, when the text states how often an adverse event occurred in patients.

modes.label: Incidence wording
modes.description: The word incidence in phrases like "at a higher incidence" when comparing adverse event rates.

modes.label: Percent after a number
modes.description: The % sign right after a number giving the share of patients with an event.
modes.example: Pneumonitis occurred in 10<<%>> of patients treated with ELAHERE,

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a frequency statement and away from words for rare or occasional events.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label states how often a side effect happened, as an incidence or a percentage.
